content_sections.heading: About Panjab University Guest Faculty (Assistant Professor)
content_sections.text: This recruitment is conducted by the Centre for Nanoscience and Nanotechnology, located at South Campus, Block-II, Sector-25, Panjab University, Chandigarh-160014. The selected candidate will teach students at the Centre on a lecture basis for the academic session 2026-27 while abiding by specific terms regarding financial assistance and fellowships.

content_sections.text: FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

rows.qualification: M.Sc./M.Tech. in Nanoscience & Nanotechnology / Renewable Energy / Physics / Chemistry / Materials Science with at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/Physically & Visually handicapped) or equivalent grade, plus National Eligibility Test (NET) cleared. Candidates awarded a Ph.D. degree as per UGC Regulations 2009 are exempted from NET.
rows.experience: Desirable: Ph.D. degree in Faculty of Science or Faculty of Engineering with demonstrated research experience in Renewable Energy, Nanoscience & Nanotechnology, or Materials Science supported by research publications in peer reviewed journals/patents.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The assignment is on a lecture basis carrying an honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per lecture with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The candidate must undertake that he/she will not draw any fellowship, stipend, or financial assistance from any agency while teaching at the Centre for Nanoscience and Nanotechnology as a Guest Faculty.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Panjab University Guest Faculty (Assistant Professor)
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the Panjab University website using the official link. Fill out the application form with all required details. Submit the filled application so that it reaches on or before 05.11.2026 till 05:00 p.m. in the office of the Centre for Nanoscience and Nanotechnology, Panjab University. Ensure shortlisting criteria are met to receive an e-mail or phone call notification for the interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Original certificates and other relevant documents for verification at the time of interview

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The post is filled through interview on a purely temporary basis for the academic session 2026-27. Shortlisted candidates will be notified regarding the date and time of the interview by e-mail or phone call. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. Candidates must bring original certificates and relevant documents during verification at the interview. The candidate must not draw fellowship, stipend, or financial assistance from any other agency during the assignment.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 01 vacancy available for the Guest Faculty (Assistant Professor) position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form is 05.11.2026 up to 05:00 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an M.Sc. or M.Tech. degree in Nanoscience & Nanotechnology, Renewable Energy, Physics, Chemistry, or Materials Science with at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/PH/VH), along with NET qualification or an exempted Ph.D. degree as per UGC Regulations 2009.

faq.question: Q4. What is the honorarium offered for this position?
faq.answer: The honorarium is Rs. 1500/- per lecture with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the interview?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, the date and time of which will be notified separately by e-mail or phone call.

faq.question: Q6. Where should the application form be submitted?
faq.answer: The application form must reach the office of the Centre for Nanoscience and Nanotechnology, Panjab University on or before 05.11.2026 till 05:00 p.m.

faq.question: Q7. Is any TA/DA provided for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.
